document.title: Eval harness: stop the CLI hunt, run graders without tools
document.summary: The producer prompt names the injected `node <abs>/dist/cli/main.js` command as the built CLI. Graders get the packet inline, keep `read`/`grep`/`glob`/`ls`, and the prompt tells them to start from the packet and read only the files a check needs. Agent runs record tool calls so the eval line can print CLI-hunt and grader-tool counts.
document.why: [#97](source:s1) cuts CI eval cost: the producer prompt was sending the agent to verify the CLI path, and graders spent most of their tokens finding the packet and walking the tree.

sources.title: Eval harness: stop the CLI hunt in the producer prompt, run graders without tools
sources.gist: CI cost, not the user path: state the injected CLI as a fact, and put the grading packet inline so graders waste fewer steps finding it.

sources.label: PR #100
sources.title: Eval harness: stop the CLI hunt, run graders without tools
sources.gist: Producer CLI-hunt fix, inline grading packet, graders keep work-tree tools, tool-call telemetry. No tools:[] and no step cap.

lookFor: [#97](source:s1) offered a tool-less grader as one option. This change keeps grader tools so they can check the code. There is no step cap.
[#97](source:s1) asks for before/after CLI-hunt steps and grader tokens. `formatRunTotals` is the on-branch measurement; it is not a pass/fail.

groups.title: Record tool calls on each agent run
groups.why: Later groups print CLI-hunt and grader-tool counts. That needs `onStep` traces on `AgentRunResult`.
groups.summary: `runLocalAgent` records assistant steps and tool names plus a short detail, and `isCliHuntCall` classifies dist/CLI hunts.
lookFor: Subtle. `glob **/*` is not a CLI hunt unless the pattern names dist, cli/main, or package.json.

groups.title: Name the injected CLI as a built fact
groups.why: [#97](source:s1) says “The CLI named in the skill is the local build” sent the producer hunting for a path, and once built the reviewed repo’s older CLI.
groups.summary: `producerPrompt` takes `cliPath` and tells the agent that `node <abs>/dist/cli/main.js` is the CLI, it is already built, and it must run that command as written.
lookFor: The producer `review` and `validate` shell commands should be `node /…/dist/cli/main.js`, not a build of the work tree’s own CLI.

groups.title: Inline the packet; keep work-tree tools
groups.why: [#97](source:s1) says graders spent most eval tokens finding the packet and walking the tree. Mate’s review of [PR #100](source:s2) keeps the tools so they can check the code.
groups.summary: `groupingPrompt` and `prosePrompt` embed the packet and tell the grader to start from it, then read only the files a check needs. `GRADER_TOOLS` stays `read`/`grep`/`glob`/`ls`.
lookFor: Subtle. The prompt still allows work-tree reads. `GRADER_TOOLS` is not empty. There is no maxSteps field on the agent run.

commits.subject: Stop counting eval temp paths as CLI hunts.
commits.author: Cursor Agent
commits.body:
A grep whose path contains the case id was matching \`comprehende\` and inflating cli-hunt totals.

Co-authored-by: Máté Molnár <matemolnar8@users.noreply.github.com>

commits.subject: Give graders tools back and keep the packet inline.
commits.author: Cursor Agent
commits.body:
Graders keep read, grep, glob, and ls so they can check grouping and claims against the work tree. The prompt still embeds the packet and tells them to start from it, with targeted reads only, and no step cap.

Co-authored-by: Máté Molnár <matemolnar8@users.noreply.github.com>

commits.subject: Keep the prose grader's ask list and tighten CLI-hunt matching.
commits.author: Cursor Agent
commits.body:
Restore the frozen-source / summary / lookFor questions in the inline packet prompt. Count glob as a CLI hunt only when the pattern names dist, cli/main, or package.json, not a generic **/*.

Co-authored-by: Máté Molnár <matemolnar8@users.noreply.github.com>

commits.subject: Stop the eval CLI hunt and run graders with no tools.
commits.author: Cursor Agent
commits.body:
The producer prompt now states the injected `node <abs>/dist/cli/main.js` path as a built fact. Graders get the packet inline and an empty tool list so they cannot walk the work tree.

Co-authored-by: Máté Molnár <matemolnar8@users.noreply.github.com>
